description.zh: 即通过文件名称对接口返回的文件详情列表进行过滤。默认值为空，即不使用文件名称对结果进行过滤。
description.en: Filters the returned file details list by file name. Default value: empty, which means no filtering by file name.

description.zh:
即通过文件导入状态对接口返回的文件列表进行过滤。取值范围：

- INSERT_ERROR：导入索引失败。
- RUNNING：索引构建中。
- DELETED：已经删除。
- FINISH：索引构建成功。
- PARSE_FAILED：解析失败
- DOC_PARSING：解析中

默认值为空，即不使用文件导入状态对结果进行过滤。
description.en:
Filters the returned file list by file import status. Valid values:

- INSERT_ERROR: Failed to import to the index.
- RUNNING: Index building in progress.
- DELETED: Deleted.
- FINISH: Index building succeeded.
- PARSE_FAILED: Parsing failed.
- DOC_PARSING: Parsing in progress.

Default value: empty, which means no filtering by file import status.

description.zh:
是否开启文件名称的模糊匹配，与`DocumentName`参数配合使用。取值范围：

- true：根据文件名称对接口返回的文件列表进行模糊匹配。
- false：默认根据文件名称进行精确匹配。

默认值为 false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable fuzzy matching for file names. This parameter is used together with the `DocumentName` parameter. Valid values:

- true: Performs fuzzy matching on the returned file list based on the file name.
- false: Performs exact matching on the returned file list based on the file name.

Default value: false.

description.zh: 知识库 ID，即 **CreateIndex** 接口返回的`Data.Id`。
description.en: The knowledge base ID, which is the `Data.Id` returned by the **CreateIndex** operation.

description.zh: 指定要查询的页码。起始值为 1。默认值为 1。
description.en: The page number to query. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时每页展示的文件数量 ，最大值10。
description.en: The number of files to display per page for paging. Maximum value: 10.

description.zh: 知识库所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见[如何使用业务空间](~~2587495~~)。
description.en: The ID of the workspace to which the knowledge base belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [How to use a workspace](~~2587495~~).

title.zh: 查询知识库下的文件详情
title.en: Query file details in a knowledge base

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户（子账号）需要首先获取阿里云百炼的[API权限](~~2848578~~)（需要`AliyunBailianDataFullAccess`，已包括sfm:ListIndexFiles权限点），然后才能调用本接口。阿里云账号（主账号）可直接调用无须授权。建议您通过最新版<props="china">[阿里云百炼SDK](https://api.aliyun.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29)</props><props="intl">[阿里云百炼SDK](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29)</props>来调用本接口。
- 调用本接口前，请确保您的知识库已经创建完成且未被删除（即知识库 ID`IndexId`有效）。
- 本接口具有幂等性。
descriptions.en:
- Resource Access Management (RAM) users must first obtain [API permissions](~~2848578~~) for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (`AliyunBailianDataFullAccess` is required, which includes the sfm:ListIndexFiles permission), before invoking this operation. Alibaba Cloud accounts can invoke this operation directly without authorization. Use the latest <props="china">[Alibaba Cloud Model Studio SDK](https://api.aliyun.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29)</props><props="intl">[Alibaba Cloud Model Studio SDK](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api-tools/sdk/bailian?version=2023-12-29)</props> to invoke this operation.
- Before invoking this operation, make sure that your knowledge base has been created and has not been deleted (that is, the knowledge base ID `IndexId` is valid).
- This operation has idempotence.
